name: How long does it take to install a new water heater?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a new water heater typically depends on the type and complexity of the job. A standard replacement of a tank water heater in the same location can often be completed within 2 to 4 hours. If you're upgrading to a tankless unit, or if significant plumbing or venting modifications are required, the process might take longer, sometimes a full day. Our technicians work efficiently to minimize disruption and ensure a proper, safe installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard tank water heater replacement usually takes 2-4 hours. Upgrading to a tankless unit or complex installations may take longer, up to a full day.
